review_notes.status: Private source-only RX901 transcription reviewed against the native TIFF: 35 printed boxes, 50 input terminals, all visible routes and right/left continuations, and the lower connector table are entered. No raster background is used. Retain privately for root acceptance.

review_notes.evidence: RX901 native boxes 0-2.png and RX901 full bodies 0-5.png show all 35 native boxes on the standard 23-column, 7-row lattice. The 0537D1 interrupt box is printed 3G, correcting a provisional 3F inventory label; RX901 0537D1 box actual grid.png is decisive.

Source crops tmp/ald-text/rx/root/RX901 title.png, tmp/ald-text/rx/root/RX901 header.png, and tmp/ald-text/rx/root/RX901 left-footer.png show the REPEAT ROS ADDRESS title, part 2586044, P.N. periods, machine 7201-02, margin RX901, and footer identifiers. The connector footer is independently visible in tmp/ald-text/rx/early/RX901 connector footer full.png.

RX901 full bodies 5.png shows 7A D13/B13, 7C D06/D02, 7D D13/B13 test point, 7E D06/D02 test point, and 7F D06/D02 with their native triangle/plain shapes. RX901 full bodies 4.png shows 6F D06 and B02 test-point terminals. Their rails and continuations are visible in RX901 right continuations high.png.

RX901 full bodies 2-4.png show 4A B12/D10; 4F, 4G, 4J, 4K, 4M, 4N paired native input pin strings and plain outputs; 5G, 5K, 5N two blank inputs and marked triangle outputs; and 5A, 5B paired input labels with plain outputs. The source-visible pins are entered without assuming adjacent-wire connectivity.

RX901 3A ports native high.png shows two blank OR inputs plus D12T and B10 outputs. RX901 full bodies 1-2.png and RX901 0537D1 box actual grid.png show native 3E, 3G, 3H, 3K, 3L, and 3N input/output labels. The 3G/3K/3N interrupt outputs are distinct from their separate repeat-box inputs.

RX901 bank1-2 top terminal routes native.png and RX901 full bodies 0-1.png show the left D09/D13/B02 terminals, 2A/2B paired input labels, and 2F/2J paired AR-T outputs. RX901 2M native ports high.png shows 2M D05 input, B02 upper output, and a second blank output. The upper wrap and three clock/reset routes are corroborated by RX901 bank2 top clock origin.png and RX901 clock rails high.png.

RX901 ST42 connector entire.png has a visibly open third glyph and reads LS1C1AA4 in the native print. The A1 socket listing references LS101AA4 instead; this is documented as a native/A1 discrepancy, plausibly a damaged zero, and the transcription retains the visible native C.
